description: Wander through the woods with 30 original forest-animal coloring pages. Meet foxes, deer, owls, bears, rabbits, squirrels, raccoons, hedgehogs, birds, wolves, and more woodland friends — each in bold, friendly line art with trees, mushrooms, and nature details to color. Single-sided pages help markers and gel pens stay on one design. AI-assisted artwork — disclosed on KDP upload.
